services:
  data_store_backend:
    build:
      context: ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend
      args:
        INDEX_URL: ${PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}
    command: sh scripts/start-server.sh
    volumes:
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend:/app
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend/data_store:/data_store
    container_name: data-store-backend-service
    ports:
      - 8007:8000
    environment:
      - API__ENVIRONMENT=COMPOSE_ALL===
services:
  schp_db:
    image: postgres:14.7-alpine
    restart: on-failure
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=admin
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=adminadmin123456
    container_name: schp-postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: pg_isready -U admin -d postgres
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 8
      start_period: 2s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
===
volumes:
  kafka-broker:
services:
  kafka_broker:
    image: "bitnamilegacy/kafka:4.0.0-debian-12-r10"
    container_name: kafka-broker
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "9101:9101"
    environment:
      - BITNAMI_DEBUG=false
      - KAFKA_CFG_LOG4J_ROOT_LOGLEVEL=ERROR
      - KAFKA_CFG_NODE_ID=1
      - KAFKA_ENABLE_KRAFT=yes
      - KAFKA_CFG_PROCESS_ROLES=broker,controller
      - KAFKA_CFG_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES=CONTROLLER
      - KAFKA_CFG_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://kafka-broker:29092,CONTROLLER://kafka-broker:29093,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:9092
      - KAFKA_CFG_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP=CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      - KAFKA_CFG_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://kafka-broker:29092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:9092
      - KAFKA_CFG_BROKER_ID=1
      - KAFKA_CFG_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS=1@kafka-broker:29093
      - ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_LISTENER=yes
      - KAFKA_KRAFT_CLUSTER_ID=r4zt_wrqTRuT7W2NJsB_GA
    volumes:
      - kafka-broker:/bitnami/kafka
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "/opt/bitnami/kafka/bin/kafka-broker-api-versions.sh",
          "--bootstrap-server",
          "kafka-broker:29092",
        ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

  kafka-ui:
    container_name: kafka-ui
    image: "provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest"
    depends_on:
      - kafka_broker
    ports:
      - "8092:8080"
    environment:
      LOGGING_LEVEL_ROOT: error
      LOGGING_LEVEL_COM_PROVECTUS: error
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS: "kafka-broker:29092"
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local-kafka-cluster

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/services/data_store_backend/service.yml; echo ===; cat deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/commons/postgres_db.yml | head -40; echo ===; head -60 deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/commons/kafka.yml
